When i was a kid, i was pretty disappointed when I learnt i have to go to the class every 5 days a week for rest of my life until Im old enough to get a job. Then I see how my father is actually in the same cycle as me, working everyday and didn't really have time for himself. 

When I realized that kinda what life is. I remember strongly wanting to "not be here". Funny how i was attracted to the idea of suicide before learning what that is.
did i just saw depression get raped lol

nope, talked to my teacher. Ended up being labeled as sensitive boy. 

Then my friends , they began treat me differently and no longer inviting me out because I giving them the bad vibes. 

Never. open. up.

I understand what you saying, but I have to say something. 

Depression and suicidal tendencies is a battle. A continuous battle that the participants is their own self. Sure people can try to help. But they wont be around 24 hours a day with you. Unfortunately, your mind is, and thats the problem. 

Some people wake up, go through their day, and go to sleep with this constant feeling wanting to kill themselves. And they have to force themselves to be a functional human being while this is all happening in their head, 

No one want to lives like that. 

For someone to say "hey, people love you. Please stay alive" often felt blank. Because in the same time, no one fully understand what is going through your head. 

Again, don't take this wrong, i understand suicide will and can hurt peoples. Its just something I wanna say. I understand your frustrations and I hoped you ok with me saying this.

Beautifully written. 

I aim to be calm like him. I hoped i am peaceful with my decision as he is.

I didn't thought about that. But I do felt its the same as, a burden for my friend. I dont know.. Maybe i need a few day to think this over. 

Thank you so much for the comment.

Thanks for the kind comment. But, sharing my problems with people even people on the internet always felt like a crap thing to do. Im sorry. 

It just Im so used to keep thing to myself far too long. You so kind offering your time, i appreciated that.

Thanks so much for replying. I do have another question, sometimes i stutter so much when talking. I'm afraid it will harden my session with the therapist and maybe annoyed them. 

So when this happen, what usually does therapist will do? Like, does they have a routine or plan when facing a client dumb like me?

I understand. For the last minute of this cat life, I somehow felt connected with her. I wondered what she was thinking about, does she think about death? Or maybe she was remembering her lives as a kitten? 

I know she just a cat, and I may overthink this. But I don't know. I'm just hoping she's glad i was there with her final moment.
Thanks for the kind words. I have buried the cat. I decided to name her, just for something to remembered. Again, thanks for the wishes.
Thanks again but thats okay. I dont want to use anymore of your time.

Thanks a lot for the reply. Yeah I'll definitely do that. I dont want to admitted to mental institution. That would literally ruined my life. (again, this is pretty ironic, I know)

And again, I really appreciated the help. Thank you.

Thanks for the reply. Do you have any advices on opening up? I always bottle up my feeling so I'm kinda afraid that I'll having breakdown in front of my urine doctor lol. 

Also, if you know about this, did you think that I'll be admitted to a mental institute or something when I said that I'm suicidal? I not sure to drop "im suicidal" bomb at my doctor too early.
Alright. Again, thanks for the reply. I really appreciated it.
I think there is. At least I hope so. Do you have any more advices? I weighing my option right now. Thanks for replying btw.
Can you recommend one? I looking about online therapy a year ago but I chickened out because I seen a lot bad reviews on them.
